Terms of use: Shopify app „Logical Knight Workbench“

Version 2026-11-08 · This version is not changed after publication; a new version gets a new address. Language of the contract: English. Related: Data processing agreement, version 2026-11-08 · Privacy policy, section 5b · Legal notice

1. Provider, scope and conclusion

Provider: Leo King, trading as Logical Knight, Große Holl 32, 22115 Hamburg, Germany (sole proprietor; provider details per § 5 DDG in the legal notice). Contact: support@logicalknight.com.

These terms govern the use of the Shopify app „Logical Knight Workbench“ (the app) by the merchant who installs it. The app connects a Shopify shop with a Logical Knight Data Workbench organisation. It requires such an organisation, which is used under its own terms (Free Early Access); these terms do not replace or alter them.

The app is offered only to entrepreneurs within the meaning of § 14 BGB (businesses acting in their trade or profession), not to consumers.

Conclusion. The contract is concluded when a person signed in to the merchant's Shopify admin accepts these terms and the data processing agreement in the app (step “Link this shop”) on the merchant's behalf. The app links the shop and processes product data only after that acceptance. Before acceptance, only what the app needs to open and present these terms is stored (the shop address, the access tokens issued by Shopify and the installing user's Shopify user ID; their role and basis are set out in section 1 of the data processing agreement). The app records who accepted which version and when, and shows it in the app. These terms and the data processing agreement remain retrievable and can be saved or printed at their versioned addresses.

2. What the app does

  • It previews changes from approved Data Workbench results against the live catalogue: drafts to be created, field and price changes, added variants and images, and variants not in the file, which are kept.
  • It writes only what the merchant approves, exactly as previewed, and refuses when the catalogue changed after the preview.
  • It records every operation with its result and the previous values.

3. What it does not do

  • It does not publish products, change product status or delete products or images.
  • It deletes a variant only when the merchant ticks it and confirms.
  • It does not read customers or orders.
  • It does not synchronise without approval. Schedules run only with the actions the merchant authorised; variant deletion is never scheduled.

4. The merchant's responsibility

The merchant checks the preview before approving. A preview may warn about unusual price changes; a warning does not replace that check. The merchant is responsible for the content of the supplier files and the approved results, including prices and currency. The app never converts currencies and refuses when the currencies differ.

5. Recovery limits

Field changes to products and variants can be reverted from the recorded previous values, with a new preview and approval. Not undone: created products (they remain drafts), added images and deleted variants (their previous values remain in the audit). Restoring a Logical Knight database backup does not undo writes already made in Shopify. There is no universal undo.

6. Availability and support

During Free Early Access no service level, availability or uptime is promised. Support is provided on a best-effort basis via support@logicalknight.com.

7. Fees

The app is free while Data Workbench is in Free Early Access. No charge is made under these terms. Any future pricing would be set out in a new version of these terms, announced in advance, accepted by the merchant before it applies and handled in line with Shopify's rules then in force.

8. Data protection

The data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR), version 2026-11-08, accepted together with these terms, governs the processing of the merchant's data. Privacy information: privacy policy, section 5b.

9. Liability

Liability is governed by the applicable statutory provisions. Mandatory liability, in particular for intent and gross negligence, for injury to life, body or health, under the Product Liability Act (Produkthaftungsgesetz) and under Art. 82 GDPR, remains unaffected.

10. Term, end and changes

The terms apply while the app is installed. Either party may end them at any time: the merchant by uninstalling the app, the provider by notice to the shop's contact address with reasonable notice, except for good cause. Deletion then follows the data processing agreement and privacy section 5b.

Changes take effect only when the merchant accepts a new version in the app. Until then the accepted version continues to apply; a merchant who does not accept may uninstall the app.

11. Law and jurisdiction

German law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. If the merchant is a merchant (Kaufmann) within the meaning of the German Commercial Code, a legal entity under public law or a special fund under public law, or has no general place of jurisdiction in Germany, the exclusive place of jurisdiction for all disputes under these terms is Hamburg (§ 38 ZPO). Otherwise the statutory rules on jurisdiction apply.
